summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) end-to-end: implement vault blob v2 binary format across the TypeScript core, server API, Rust desktop app, and web client, including security review and human-verified checkpoint.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (6/6 must-haves passed). Migration confirmed working in production DB. Security review fixed 2 HIGH issues. Multiple UAT-discovered bugs fixed including v2 blob handling in folder sync and recovery tool IPNS resolution.

repo: NestJS API does not auto-log incoming requests — cannot confirm API calls from server logs alone; must query DB directly to verify state changes

orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields even when OpenAPI spec is correct — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround, not a DTO fix
IPFS Kubo API port 5001 has no CORS headers — cannot be called from browser context; use the gateway (port 8080) instead which sets `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`
IPFS gateway supports `/ipns/{name}` path resolution with `X-Ipfs-Roots` response header containing the resolved CID — eliminates need for separate IPNS resolution API calls from browser
Subfolder IPNS records are only stored in the CipherBox API DB cache, never published to the public DHT — recovery tool cannot traverse subfolders without API auth
The CipherBox API IPNS resolve endpoint requires JWT auth — cannot be used by the standalone recovery tool
Vault migration executed silently on first browser session before Playwright testing began — `migrated_at` was already set in DB when investigation started

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without checking for v2 binary format header — crashes with SyntaxError when encountering migrated v2 blobs
Same v2 blob handling bug as folder.service.ts — same fix required in SDK
fetchFromIpfs could return undefined on non-404 HTTP errors (502/503) — loop fell through without returning, causing detectBlobVersion to crash on undefined.length
extractCidFromIpnsRecord parsed delegated routing CBOR-wrapped records as raw protobuf, producing garbage binary CID strings — fixed by requesting JSON format from routing API
serialize_vault_blob_v2 had no key length bounds checks — silent u16 truncation possible for keys >65535 bytes; now returns Result with explicit validation
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse used #[derive(Debug)] exposing encrypted key material in debug output — replaced with custom impls that redact sensitive fields
Desktop vault init was ECIES-wrapping rootFolderKey twice with the same public key — once for DB storage and once for v2 blob; second wrap now reuses first
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs in PATH A; also had redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair into identical rootIpnsKeypair object

workflow: When API calls appear missing from server logs, query the database directly — NestJS silence does not mean the call never happened
IPFS gateway HEAD request to `/ipns/{name}` returns `X-Ipfs-Roots` header — cleaner than delegated routing API for browser-based IPNS resolution, avoids CORS and protobuf parsing entirely
Security review should run on all crypto code before checkpoint approval, not after — HIGH issues were found and fixed that would have been missed
OTP codes appear in clear text in dev server stdout — can be retrieved programmatically from background task output
Playwright `browser_evaluate` can extract Zustand store state (including crypto key material) for testing — useful for feeding values into recovery tools

friction: Vault migration appeared to fail silently for entire debugging session — root cause was NestJS not logging requests, requiring DB query to confirm success; cost significant investigation time

Recovery tool had 5 cascading IPNS resolution bugs: undefined return, garbage CID from protobuf parsing, CORS block on Kubo API, auth requirement on CipherBox API, and missing gateway /ipns/ path strategy
orval codegen bug with nullable string fields required reverting a DTO + API client regeneration attempt — the fix does nothing because the OpenAPI spec was already correct
Subfolder IPNS records not on public DHT means recovery tool cannot fully traverse folder trees in local dev or when records haven't propagated
Security review found serialize_vault_blob_v2 now returns Result which required updating all call sites and test unwrap() calls — cascading edit burden
open_items: Device registry sync fails with 'CryptoError: Invalid registry format' — schema mismatch between current registry format and IPFS-stored data (todo: fix-device-registry-cryptoerror-invalid-registry-format)
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure in dev environment (todo: fix-bin-ipns-name-404-resolution-failure)
E2e tests for vault v2 recovery tool — full exercise of both recovery methods including v2 blob path (todo: add-e2e-tests-for-vault-v2-recovery-tool)
Recovery tool subfolder traversal requires IPNS records on public DHT — subfolders unreachable without CipherBox API auth; needs architectural decision

Security review medium issues deferred: M-1 (recovery private key not zeroed after use), M-2 (no concurrent migration dedup guard across tabs), M-3 (unnecessary ECIES re-wrap on every FUSE root folder publish)
Security review low issues deferred: L-1 (zero-length key accepted by deserializers), L-2 (no SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html)
